g.text: Embers local development stack - docker topology
(compose projects, containers, ports, and the co-located F1r3drive FUSE mount)
(AES cipher key, generated on first run)
All containers join the same external bridge network, so services address
the node by its container DNS name (rnode.rust-standalone). The FUSE mount
never crosses a container boundary - the co-location is what makes the
stack behave identically on Linux, macOS, and Windows (Docker Desktop runs
every container on a Linux kernel).
